overallShapeHypotheses.label: Two paired-panel platforms with an intervening green ramp
overallShapeHypotheses.reasoning: Final shows a purple-roof rear assembly, green descending panels, and a red-roof two-bay front assembly with downward yellow flaps. This is consistent with a toy-car ramp context, not evidence of wheels or a vehicle body.
overallShapeHypotheses.uncertainty: The lower ramp and rear interior are obscured; exact final contacts and enclosure completeness are unresolved.

hiddenStructureHypotheses.description: The first-step rear blue floors, right side, purple rear faces and right orange support may remain behind the final ramp.
hiddenStructureHypotheses.reasoning: t04–t08 and t10 are directly observed in a46687756c575adb7d1401d31d0e8c667c794f80bc483644c4601b25cb03fbcc. The same paired purple roof, left blue side and left orange support persist in final, supporting assembly continuity.
hiddenStructureHypotheses.uncertainty: These six entries have conditional final membership. Their retention is not equivalent to direct final visibility; removals or replacements remain possible.

hiddenStructureHypotheses.description: Additional rear-facing panels or a central divider could be hidden within either platform.
hiddenStructureHypotheses.reasoning: Roofs and opaque-looking transparent overlaps conceal some internal boundaries.
hiddenStructureHypotheses.uncertainty: No additional physical tiles are added for these possibilities; symmetry or a familiar box construction is insufficient evidence.

alternatives.label: Rear assembly modified between steps
alternatives.description: Some of t04–t08 or t10 may have been removed or replaced while the visible roof and outer-left side were retained. The canonical inventory therefore carries these observed physical instances conditionally, rather than asserting 23 confirmed final tiles.
alternatives.uncertainty: The supplied frames do not resolve this.

alternatives.label: Lower green panels fold differently behind the front assembly
alternatives.description: The four-panel ramp is clearly exposed in d3677ba6109be40b4613ac19f113a588951f305a4e2d93eef078884493419b8a, but the final lower panels may continue the upper slope or hinge to a different inclination.
alternatives.uncertainty: Final occlusion prevents choosing a precise lower-ramp pose.

alternatives.label: Yellow flaps nearly vertical
alternatives.description: The yellow triangles may lie close to vertical rather than being substantially tilted; perspective and transparent overlap allow both readings.

unknowns: Final membership is conditional for six step-only observations: t04, t05, t06, t07, t08 and t10.
Seventeen instances have distinguishable final-image evidence; six additional previously observed instances are retained conditionally. This is not a verified exact total for all hidden tiles.
The front outer-right blue panel t18 is identifiable mainly by its exposed upright frame; full shape and extent are uncertain.
The final ramp-to-front-platform attachment, if any, is not established.
Complete enclosure, hidden middle panels and unseen bottoms are not assumed.
Numerical fold angles other than approximate flat/right-angle candidates are not recoverable from these views.
All coordinates are normalized top-left image coordinates; bbox values are [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax].
Reference-image boxes are null for pieces without independently distinguishable final-image evidence. Their actual step evidence remains in imageEvidence.
The supplied Final image determines the target state. Step images support identity and occlusion reasoning, not additional stage inventories.
Cross-frame identities rely on outline, relative scale, neighbors and construction context; identical color alone is not used as proof.
The catalog provides candidate intrinsic profiles, not measured physical dimensions. Triangle subtypes and partially hidden quadrilateral profiles remain uncertain.
No metric reconstruction, complete geometry validation or planar reconstruction safety is asserted.
